name: Quick Slash
description: Deliver a fast, low-commitment melee slash intended for reliable close-range pressure.

name: Heavy Swing
description: Commit to a slower, forceful weapon swing that deals high damage across a broad melee arc.

name: Spear Thrust
description: Drive a spear straight forward to strike a target from extended melee reach.

name: Shield Bash
description: Slam a shield into a nearby enemy to deal damage and briefly stagger or interrupt them.
statusApplications: Stagger 0.6 s; bosses become Interrupt-Resistant rather than immune where possible.

name: Guard
description: Enter a defensive stance that improves active blocking while relying on the normal stamina cost of absorbed attacks.
statusApplications: Uses Hytale-native block/parry and stamina-drain behavior; do not duplicate the block resource model.

name: Quickstep
description: Dash a short distance in the chosen movement direction to reposition or evade danger.

name: Dagger Flurry
description: Perform a rapid sequence of dagger strikes against enemies directly in front of the player.

name: Maul Swing
description: Swing a heavy weapon with crushing force to punish a target at close range.

name: Scythe Sweep
description: Manifest or sweep a scythe through a wide frontal arc to cut multiple nearby enemies.

name: Pounce
description: Leap toward a target and strike on arrival.

name: Dive Strike
description: Leap or dive rapidly onto a target area and strike enemies at the landing point.

name: Spark
description: Strike a nearby target with a burst of heat and flame.

name: Jump Strike
description: Leap toward a target point and deliver a weapon strike when landing.

name: Charge
description: Rush forward with a spear, damaging and displacing the first enemy hit.
statusApplications: Knockback 3 m or brief stagger on first target.

name: Finishing Strike
description: Deliver a combo-finisher that gains increased power after the player has built the required combat state.
powerCoefficient: 1.20x Weapon Power baseline; 1.80x when Finisher condition is satisfied.

name: Whirlwind
description: Spin with the equipped weapon, striking all nearby enemies around the player.
targetMode: 4.2 m radius  /  360° nova centered on caster

name: Execution Strike
description: Deliver a high-impact strike that becomes significantly stronger against low-health targets.

name: Riposte
description: Enter a brief counter window and retaliate with a fast strike after successfully avoiding or blocking an attack.
targetMode: 3.0 m  /  counter window then single-target strike

name: Backstab
description: Strike from behind for greatly increased damage against a valid target.
targetMode: 2.4 m  /  single target; requires rear 120° arc
powerCoefficient: 1.90x Light Power when positional requirement passes; 0.90x otherwise.

name: Frenzy
description: Enter an aggressive stance that ramps attack speed and pressure while combat is maintained.
statusApplications: Gain 1 Frenzy stack per successful weapon hit, max 5; each stack \+4% attack speed; stacks decay after 3 s without a hit.

name: Void Dash
description: Dash rapidly through space and leave a brief void disturbance along the path.

name: Axe Toss
description: Throw a battleaxe in a straight line to damage the first enemy it reaches.

name: Spear Toss
description: Throw a spear over medium range to impale the first valid target struck.

name: Quick Shot
description: Fire a fast, low-cost ranged shot with minimal recovery time.
travelSpeed: Use native projectile speed for equipped bow/crossbow where available.

name: Crossbow Bolt
description: Launch a powerful crossbow bolt in a straight line with strong single-target impact.

name: Blunderbuss Shot
description: Fire a short-range spread of pellets in a widening cone.
powerCoefficient: 8 × 0.22x Light Power; one target may receive multiple pellets

name: Web Shot
description: Launch a sticky web projectile that roots the first susceptible target hit.
statusApplications: Root 2.5 s; bosses receive 30% Slow for 2.5 s instead of root.

name: Fire Bolt
description: Launch a fast bolt of fire that damages the first target hit and can ignite it.
statusApplications: Burn 4 s.

name: Frost Bolt
description: Launch a bolt of frost that damages the first target hit and applies Chill.
statusApplications: Applies 1 Chill stack.

name: Arcane Bolt
description: Fire a compact arcane projectile that deals reliable magic damage to the first target hit.

name: Void Bolt
description: Fire a void-charged projectile that damages the first target struck with void magic.

name: Stone Bolt
description: Hurl a compact mass of stone that deals earth damage and strong impact.
statusApplications: Minor knockback 1.5 m.

name: Bone Shard
description: Launch a sharpened bone projectile that deals necrotic damage.

name: Snipe
description: Instantly release a fully charged bow shot for massive single-target damage without the normal charge-up period.
targetMode: Use equipped bow validated maximum projectile range; single projectile / native arrow hitbox
maxRange: Use equipped bow validated maximum projectile range; single projectile
travelSpeed: Use equipped bow native fully charged projectile speed
statusApplications: No built-in crowd control. The shot counts as fully charged for compatible weapon/Link interactions, but does not duplicate unrelated native charge-trigger side effects unless explicitly whitelisted.

name: Explosive Flask
description: Throw an alchemical flask that detonates on impact and damages enemies in a small area.

name: Bomb Toss
description: Throw an explosive bomb that detonates after impact or a short fuse.

name: Arcane Missiles
description: Launch several arcane missiles that independently track a selected target or nearby targets.
targetMode: 26 m target lock  /  5 missiles; 0.22 m each

name: Fireball
description: Launch a large fire projectile that explodes on impact and damages enemies around the detonation.
targetMode: 30 m max  /  0.50 m projectile; 4.0 m impact radius
statusApplications: Burn 5 s to enemies within 3 m of impact.

name: Cold Blast
description: Fire a concentrated blast of cold that deals frost damage and applies multiple Chill stacks.
statusApplications: Applies 2 Chill stacks.

name: Ground Slam
description: Smash the ground to create a radial shockwave that damages nearby enemies.
statusApplications: Knockback 2 m; radial falloff to 70% power at outer edge.

name: Powder Mine
description: Place an explosive trap that detonates when a hostile target enters its trigger area.
targetMode: 4 m placement  /  2.5 m trigger / 4.0 m explosion radius

name: Frost Nova
description: Release a radial burst of frost around the caster that damages nearby enemies and applies Chill.
statusApplications: Applies 2 Chill stacks.

name: Cold Wave
description: Project a widening wave of cold that damages enemies and heavily applies Chill.
statusApplications: Applies 2 Chill stacks; inner 6 m applies 3 stacks.

name: Root Snare
description: Create a ground snare that roots the first susceptible enemy entering its area.
statusApplications: Root 3 s on normal targets; bosses receive 35% Slow for 3 s.

name: Venom Spray
description: Spray venom in a short cone, damaging and poisoning enemies caught inside.
statusApplications: Poison 7 s; refreshes duration.

name: Blizzard
description: Create a persistent storm over a target area that repeatedly damages and Chills enemies inside.
targetMode: 24 m placement  /  6.0 m radius ground zone
powerCoefficient: 0.38x Magic Power per impact; target hit cap once per 0.75 s
statusApplications: Each successful impact applies 1 Chill stack.

name: Wall of Fire
description: Create a persistent wall of flame that damages and ignites enemies crossing or standing within it.
targetMode: 18 m placement  /  10 m long × 2 m wide × 3 m high wall
geometry: 10 m long × 2 m wide × 3 m high wall
statusApplications: Burn 5 s on entry; per-target reapplication cooldown 1 s.

name: Poison Cloud
description: Create a lingering toxic cloud that repeatedly damages and poisons enemies inside.
targetMode: 20 m placement  /  5.0 m radius ground zone
statusApplications: Poison 8 s; cloud refreshes poison while target remains inside.

name: Vortex
description: Create a persistent void vortex that pulls enemies toward its center and damages them over time.
targetMode: 20 m placement  /  5.0 m radius ground zone; 1.5 m inner core
geometry: 5.0 m radius ground zone; 1.5 m inner core
statusApplications: Pull 1.5 m/s toward center; boss pull scales by control-resistance policy.

name: Earthquake
description: Create a violent localized quake that repeatedly damages and disrupts enemies in a wide ground area.
targetMode: 18 m placement  /  7.0 m radius ground zone
statusApplications: Each pulse applies 0.4 s stagger to normal targets; boss stagger reduced by control policy.

name: Meteor
description: Call down a massive flaming meteor onto a targeted point, dealing heavy impact and explosion damage.
targetMode: 30 m ground target  /  5.0 m impact radius; 2.0 m inner core
geometry: 5.0 m impact radius; 2.0 m inner core
powerCoefficient: 2.50x Magic Power inner impact; 1.60x outer explosion
statusApplications: Burn 8 s in inner 3 m; 4 s in outer ring.

name: Comet
description: Call down a massive frozen comet that explodes on impact and applies heavy Chill in a large area.
targetMode: 30 m ground target  /  5.5 m impact radius; 2.0 m inner core
geometry: 5.5 m impact radius; 2.0 m inner core
powerCoefficient: 2.35x Magic Power inner impact; 1.50x outer explosion
statusApplications: Applies 3 Chill stacks in outer area and 5 stacks in inner 2 m, triggering Frozen when normal rules permit.

name: Avalanche
description: Cause repeated masses of ice and stone to crash into a broad target area.
targetMode: 28 m placement  /  8 m radius bombardment zone
powerCoefficient: 6 impacts × 0.70x Magic Power; per-target hit cap 3 impacts
statusApplications: Each ice impact applies 1 Chill stack; heavy stone impacts cause 0.5 s stagger.

name: Void Cataclysm
description: Unleash a battlefield-scale void bombardment that repeatedly devastates a large target zone.
targetMode: 35 m placement  /  10 m radius bombardment zone; 4 m inner core
geometry: 10 m radius bombardment zone; 4 m inner core
powerCoefficient: 8 impacts × 0.85x Magic Power plus final 2.00x detonation; per-target impact cap 5
statusApplications: Final detonation pulls normal enemies 3 m toward center immediately before damage; protected/boss displacement follows control policy.

name: Root Lash
description: Conjure a lashing root that strikes and tethers a target at medium range.
statusApplications: Root 1.5 s on normal targets after hit.

name: Wind Cutter
description: Send a narrow cutting wave of wind forward through enemies in a straight line.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: Fire a near-instant line of lightning through enemies in the targeted direction.

name: Ball Lightning
description: Create a slow-moving electrical orb that repeatedly pulses damage around itself.
targetMode: 18 m cast range; orb travels up to 18 m  /  1.8 m pulse radius
maxRange: 18 m cast range; orb travels up to 18 m

name: Void Beam
description: Channel a continuous beam of void energy toward the targeted direction or enemy.

name: Chain Lightning
description: Strike one target with lightning that jumps to additional nearby enemies.
targetMode: 22 m first target; 8 m jump radius  /  up to 4 targets
maxRange: 22 m first target; 8 m jump radius

name: Orbiting Shadow Blades
description: Summon shadow blades that orbit the caster and strike enemies that enter their path.
targetMode: 2.8 m orbit radius  /  4 blades orbit caster
statusApplications: Per-target contact cooldown 0.75 s.

name: Life Drain
description: Channel a necrotic tether that damages an enemy while restoring health to the caster.
powerCoefficient: 0.55x Magic Power damage per second; heal caster for 60% of damage actually dealt

name: Taunt
description: Force a nearby hostile target to prioritize the caster for a short duration when the target is susceptible to taunt.
statusApplications: Taunt 5 s; elite/boss susceptibility controlled by encounter tags.

name: Weakening Hex
description: Afflict one enemy with a curse that temporarily reduces its offensive effectiveness.
statusApplications: Initial baseline: -15% outgoing damage; exact stat hook remains data-driven.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: Mark one enemy as prey, improving the player's ability to track and damage that target.
statusApplications: Marked target takes \+10% Link Tree skill damage from the caster; one active Hunter's Mark per caster.

name: Battle Cry
description: Release a rallying shout that temporarily strengthens the caster and nearby allies.
statusApplications: Initial baseline: \+10% outgoing damage and \+10% movement speed to affected allies.

name: Pack Howl
description: Howl to grant a temporary combat bonus to the caster and nearby allies.
statusApplications: Initial baseline: \+12% movement speed and \+8% attack/skill damage.

name: Reflective Hide
description: Harden the caster's defenses so a portion of eligible incoming damage is reflected to the attacker.
targetMode: Self / 3 m contextual  /  Defined by family tag
geometry: 3 m contextual  /  Defined by family tag

name: Intimidate
description: Terrify a susceptible enemy, causing it to retreat or lose aggression briefly.

name: Minor Heal
description: Restore a modest amount of health to the caster or a targeted ally.

name: Thorns Aura
description: Create a persistent aura that reflects a portion of eligible incoming damage from affected allies back to attackers.
lifetime: Toggle while Mana upkeep is paid

name: Flame Weapon
description: Imbue the equipped melee weapon with fire, adding fire damage and ignition potential to weapon hits.
weaponRequirement: Swords / Longswords / Maces / Battleaxes / Spears / Daggers
powerCoefficient: \+0.30x Magic Power as bonus Fire damage on eligible weapon hits
statusApplications: Eligible hits apply Burn 4 s; Burn application internal cooldown 1 s per target.

name: Spirit Shield
description: Create a protective spirit barrier that absorbs damage and can redirect part of incoming damage away from an ally.
targetMode: 18 m ally or self  /  single-target barrier
statusApplications: When cast on ally, 20% of post-mitigation damage is redirected to caster while shield remains.

name: Managuard
description: Reserve up to 50% of maximum Mana to maintain a shield that can absorb damage up to the amount of Mana reserved.
castCost: Reserve configurable amount up to 50% maximum Mana
powerCoefficient: Shield capacity = Mana points reserved at activation (for example, reserving 50 Mana creates a 50-point shield).
statusApplications: Reserved Mana is unavailable to spend while active. Shield recharge/refresh behavior remains a separate tuning decision and must not be guessed by the executor.

name: Emanatism
description: Reserve 10% of maximum Mana to grant the caster and nearby allies 25% increased Mana Regeneration.
targetMode: 8 m radius  /  moving Aura centered on caster
powerCoefficient: \+25% Mana Regeneration to caster and allied entities currently inside the Aura.
statusApplications: Buff is refreshed by Aura presence and removed when an affected ally leaves the radius or the Aura ends.

name: Chilling Aura
description: Surround the caster with freezing air that slows nearby enemies and steadily builds Chill stacks.
lifetime: Toggle while Mana upkeep is paid
statusApplications: Enemies in aura gain 1 Chill stack every 1.5 s; existing stacks are refreshed.

name: Pedanticism
description: Reserve 20% of maximum Mana; the caster and nearby allies gain 15% Skill Cooldown Recovery while nearby enemies have eligible ability cooldowns increased by 15%.
targetMode: 8 m radius  /  moving Aura centered on caster
powerCoefficient: Caster/allies: \+15% Skill Cooldown Recovery. Enemies: \+15% duration to eligible explicit ability cooldowns.
statusApplications: Enemy penalty applies only to abilities represented by explicit cooldown metadata; ordinary attack cadence or animation timing is not silently rewritten.

name: Reaping Storm
description: Surround the caster with a moving necrotic storm that repeatedly strikes nearby enemies.
targetMode: 8 m radius  /  moving aura with radial scythe pulses
geometry: moving aura with radial scythe pulses
lifetime: Up to 8 s while Mana upkeep is paid

name: Consume Minion
description: Sacrifice one controlled summon to empower the caster or trigger a defined benefit.
targetMode: 12 m controlled summon  /  single owned summon
statusApplications: Sacrifice summon; caster gains \+20% skill damage and 10% max Health as temporary shield for 8 s.

name: Simulacrum
description: Create a temporary decoy copy that draws hostile attention away from the caster.
statusApplications: Decoy inherits caster threat signature but cannot create objective world effects.

name: Corpse Burst
description: Detonate a valid corpse at the target location to deal necrotic area damage.
targetMode: 20 m target corpse  /  4.0 m explosion radius
statusApplications: Requires a valid unconsumed corpse; corpse is consumed on successful cast.

name: Wolf Summon
description: Summon a temporary allied wolf that attacks hostile targets on the caster's behalf.
targetMode: 6 m summon placement  /  one allied wolf
powerCoefficient: Summon attacks use 0.55x Magic Power-equivalent scaling

name: Bone Cage
description: Erupt a ring of bone around a target area to root or confine enemies while blocking movement through the cage.
targetMode: 18 m placement  /  4.0 m radius ring; 2.5 m high collision/zone boundary
geometry: 4.0 m radius ring; 2.5 m high collision/zone boundary
statusApplications: Normal enemies inside are rooted for 1 s on eruption; cage collision rules must not trap bosses/world-critical entities.

name: Revive Fallen
description: Raise a valid corpse as a temporary allied undead summon.
powerCoefficient: Summon uses corpse archetype at controlled reduced stats
statusApplications: Consumes corpse; cannot revive bosses, players, unique story entities, or already-consumed corpses.

name: Summon Void Crawlers
description: Summon multiple temporary Void Crawlers that pursue and attack hostile targets.
powerCoefficient: Each crawler uses 0.40x Magic Power-equivalent attack scaling

name: Brood Call
description: Call forth a group of temporary brood creatures to overwhelm nearby enemies.
powerCoefficient: Each broodling uses 0.35x Magic Power-equivalent attack scaling

name: Dominate
description: Attempt to convert a susceptible enemy into a temporary ally under the caster's control.
statusApplications: Only targets tagged Dominatable; bosses, players, allied NPCs, quest-critical actors, and protected entities are rejected.
